meta.title: Ghassen Bargougui | Application Engineer — Java & Cloud Platforms
meta.description: Application Engineer at Rakuten in Fukuoka, Japan, working on Rakuten Card systems. Seven years of Java, API, and financial-systems work, with Kubernetes delivery, performance testing, observability, and AI-enabled personal products.

hero.name: Ghassen Bargougui
hero.title: Application Engineer
hero.headline: Java Applications, Cloud & Platform Engineering
hero.tagline: I build and modernize Java applications and the cloud platforms they run on. At Rakuten, in the Technology Incubation Team working on Rakuten Card systems, my work spans hybrid-cloud migration, Kubernetes deployments, API development, performance testing, and application observability.

paragraphs: I am an Application Engineer with seven years of Java and full-stack experience in banking, insurance, and card payments, across Tunisia, Luxembourg, and Japan. My work sits where application code meets the platform it runs on: API design, deployment, performance diagnosis, and reliable delivery.

At Rakuten, I help lead a hybrid-cloud migration alongside my manager and project manager, coordinating implementation with development, infrastructure, CI/CD, and security teams. Hands-on, I design application and infrastructure changes, build Kubernetes deployments and pipelines, run performance tests with k6 and JMeter, and adapt application logging for Cloud Logging and Kafka/Confluent.

Outside work, I build products end to end: Slide Agent, an open-source engine for generating editable PowerPoint presentations; Pockito, an app for personal and shared finances; and SubMate, a Chrome extension for subtitle translation.
about.profile: Application Engineer with seven years of Java and full-stack experience across banking, insurance, and card payments in Tunisia, Luxembourg, and Japan. At Rakuten (Technology Incubation Team, Rakuten Card systems), my work spans hybrid-cloud migration, application and infrastructure design, Kubernetes delivery, CI/CD, performance testing, and observability. Creator of the Slide Agent, Pockito, and SubMate personal projects.

experience.description: In the Technology Incubation Team, I work on Rakuten Card systems across Java application development and cloud/platform engineering, and help lead a hybrid-cloud migration alongside my manager and project manager, coordinating implementation with development, infrastructure, CI/CD, and security teams.
achievements: Upgraded the e-Navi API to JDK 25 and Helidon 4.3, resolving dependency and CDI issues, updating tests, and documenting the handover.
Designed and validated Kubernetes deployments for the JSF, API, and Engine modules as part of the hybrid-cloud migration, including services, environment configuration, and Filestore mounts.
Run performance tests with k6 and JMeter, diagnose bottlenecks, and address them through application-design changes or resource adjustments.
Reworked application logging as structured JSON for Cloud Logging (Log4j2 with a custom formatter); currently helping move file-based application and trace logs to Kafka/Confluent.
Develop Java APIs with Redis-backed session management, service-to-service calls, and LLM API integration on Kubernetes infrastructure.
Resolved deployment, SSL, and GCP-to-on-premises connectivity issues with infrastructure and security teams, and traced a Kafka messaging issue to an incorrect CDI bean scope.
Built a GitHub Actions pipeline for builds, Docker image publishing to Artifact Registry, and GKE deployments.

experience.assignment: Client assignment at BGL BNP Paribas
experience.description: Developed and maintained internal banking applications for BGL BNP Paribas, including customer mandate management for retail banking.
achievements: Delivered customer mandate management features with Spring Boot, Spring Batch, and Angular Material.
Developed REST APIs and Hibernate data access for internal applications on PostgreSQL and Oracle.
Automated builds and deployments with Maven and Jenkins, and maintained code quality through unit tests, SonarQube analysis, and peer reviews.

projects.title: BGL BNP Paribas — Mandate Management
projects.summary: Customer mandate management for retail banking.
outcomes: Developed mandate workflows with Spring Batch processing and Angular Material screens.
Added unit tests and SonarQube checks, and automated build and deployment pipelines with Maven and Jenkins.

experience.description: Modernized Java services and developed web applications with Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL.
achievements: Refactored monolithic application components into microservices as part of the Java service modernization.
Built and documented REST APIs for service integration, covering versioning and security requirements.
Automated deployments with Jenkins and Docker, reducing manual release steps.

experience.description: Built and maintained backend services for insurance and financial applications, then took on functional analysis and cross-team solution design as Analyst Developer.
achievements: Improved API response times through query optimization and caching.
Responsible for assigned backend components; worked with business, architecture, and framework teams on requirements, microservices, and API contracts.
Documented designs in UML and sequence diagrams, and acted as a primary contact for cross-team design questions.
Implemented Keycloak authentication and role-based access control, and managed CI/CD pipelines and rollback strategies.

projects.title: SalesFlow
projects.summary: Insurance workflow modernization with Camunda BPM.
outcomes: Led the migration of insurance workflows to a Camunda BPM-based architecture to reduce manual processing.
Conducted functional analysis and client workshops, and implemented multithreaded batch processing.
Integrated ActiveMQ to automate bulk-processing workflows.

projects.title: PackManager
outcomes: Built insurance product configuration APIs and refactored legacy code for maintainability.
Profiled Java execution and memory usage with JProfiler and optimized the identified bottlenecks.

projects.title: Solife Digital & Generali Portal
outcomes: Developed Angular interfaces and Java backend services for insurance brokers.
Integrated Keycloak single sign-on and BPMN-driven user flows.

projects.title: Magikforms
projects.summary: Document and digital form processing for insurance workflows.
outcomes: Built Java services for document processing, using ActiveMQ for bulk event flows.
Integrated Keycloak authorization and analyzed Java heap usage with JProfiler.

projects.title: Insurance Pricing Module
projects.summary: Insurance product pricing and premium calculation.
outcomes: Developed product configuration and premium calculation features with client-side validation.
Processed Excel pricing templates with Apache POI to improve data integration.

projects.title: Slide Agent
projects.summary: Open-source engine and MCP tooling for generating editable PowerPoint decks with native charts and layout validation.
outcomes: Built a TypeScript engine that compiles a grid-based composition language into native PowerPoint with editable charts and tables, theme colors, and embedded fonts.
Implemented text measurement from font files, layout and contrast checks, and offline OOXML schema validation.
Published the engine on npm as @slide-agent/core, with a CLI, library API, and MCP server; template filling generates decks from CSV data without model calls.

projects.title: Pockito
projects.summary: Personal and shared finance app: Flutter and Nuxt clients, Spring Boot service with REST and MCP interfaces.
outcomes: Designed a Spring Boot backend in which REST and MCP adapters share one domain service, and built the Flutter and Nuxt clients.
Integrated Keycloak authentication, OAuth discovery for MCP clients, and event-driven notifications with Redis Streams.
Built Kubernetes deployment and rollback scripts with Traefik routing, plus automated tests and end-to-end release checks.

projects.title: SubMate
projects.summary: Chrome extension for synchronized subtitle translation on Netflix, TVer, and Prime Video, translating on-device by default with optional cloud providers.
outcomes: Built a Manifest V3 extension on Chrome's on-device Translator API, with local caching and no SubMate backend, account, or telemetry.
Designed platform adapters over a shared core for TTML/WebVTT parsing, TVer HLS segment assembly, and synchronized fullscreen overlays.
Added optional cloud translation using the user's own API key, and localized the interface in English, Japanese, French, and Arabic with right-to-left support.

projects.title: Orbit Ways
projects.summary: Browser-based multiplayer strategy board game with real-time game state over WebSockets.
outcomes: Built Spring Boot session, game-state, and matchmaking services with WebSocket updates and an Angular/Ionic interface.
Containerized the application with Docker behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

projects.title: Traffic Forward
projects.summary: Spring Boot HTTP forwarding tool with configurable routing and request/response diagnostics.
outcomes: Implemented HTTP forwarding with YAML routes supporting exact paths, variables, and wildcards while preserving request data.
Added request/response logging with timing and body previews, and packaged the service for Docker Compose.
